scenes.bubble: We can't start until our phase begins.
scenes.caption: UAE e‑invoicing timing.
scenes.say: Myth or fact? You can't start e-invoicing before your phase begins.
cap: You can't start *e‑invoicing* before your phase begins.

scenes.head: Voluntary from 1 July 2026
scenes.src: UAE Electronic Invoicing Guidelines V2.0, UAE Ministry of Finance, 26 Oct 2026, ss. 8.2 and 8.3; checked 29 Oct 2026. In-scope businesses. Valorin is an independent advisory firm, not affiliated with the FTA or MoF.
scenes.say: Myth. Any business can adopt e-invoicing voluntarily from the first of July twenty twenty-six. In-scope businesses below fifty million dirhams in revenue must appoint a provider by the thirty-first of March twenty twenty-seven.
cap: Any business can adopt e‑invoicing *voluntarily* from 1 July 2026.
In‑scope businesses below AED 50m in revenue must appoint a provider by *31 March 2027*.

scenes.say: Starting early gives you time to test with real invoices.
cap: Starting early gives you time to *test with real invoices*.

scenes.disc: General information only, not legal or tax advice. Valorin is not an ASP. Valorin is an independent advisory firm, not affiliated with the FTA or MoF.
scenes.say: Valorin is not an A.S.P. We help you prepare and implement. Not sure where to start? Send us a WhatsApp.
cap: We help you prepare and implement.
